scholarships.title: American University Emerging Global Leader Scholarship

existing.funding_period: per year, renewable for up to four years
existing.description: The AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship (AU EGLS) is American University's most prestigious award for international undergraduates, covering all billable AU expenses - full tuition, room and board - for international students who need an F-1 or J-1 visa to study in the United States. It is renewable for up to four years based on continued satisfactory academic performance, and any major offered at AU is eligible. Non-billable costs such as mandatory health insurance, books, airline tickets, taxes and miscellaneous expenses are not covered and are estimated at about US $4,000 per year. The application has two mandatory steps - the Common Application and the AU EGLS application with essays - both due January 15, 2027, with late applications not considered, and finalists and winners notified by April 1, 2027.
eligibility: International student who requires a non-immigrant visa (preferably F-1 or J-1).
Demonstrated commitment to leadership, volunteerism, and community service.
Dedicated to positive civic and social change in home country.
Still enrolled in secondary/high school and graduating by June of entry year.
existing.eligibility_summary: International students who need a non-immigrant visa (F-1 or J-1) to study in the U.S.; demonstrated commitment to leadership, volunteerism, and positive civic/social change in home country; must apply via Regular Decision.
benefits: Renewable for up to four years
coverage: Renewable for up to four years
requirements: Complete Step 1 (Common Application and supporting documents) before submitting Step 2 (AU EGLS application and essays)
Submit official English proficiency scores sent directly by the testing agency; students cannot submit their own results
Confirm a minimum of US $4,000 in the bank letter and AU Declaration of Finances Form
documents: AU EGL Scholarship application and essays (via applicant portal)
Bank letter and AU Declaration of Finances Form (minimum $4,000)
Official English proficiency test scores (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, PTE, or Cambridge)
existing.english_requirement: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo English, PTE, or Cambridge Assessment English Test accepted.
application_method: Submit Common/Coalition Application by January 15, then submit AU EGL Scholarship application and essays via applicant portal
existing.selection_notes: AU EGLS applicants are encouraged to apply Regular Decision for Fall 2027, though some early applicants may be deferred for further consideration for the award. Semi-finalists and finalists must complete Zoom interviews and/or additional essay submissions. Preference is given to students who have overcome obstacles or come from diverse and underrepresented global and socioeconomic backgrounds, who show a commitment to leadership, volunteerism, community service and advancing the needs of people in their home country, who meet English proficiency requirements, and who are still enrolled in secondary school and graduating by June 2027. Finalists and award winners are notified by April 1, 2027.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving international students demonstrating exceptional leadership and commitment to social change.
existing.notes: Only two full scholarships awarded per year; up to eight partial scholarships (up to $40,000/year) also available. Separate scholarship application required after admission application. Not eligible: U.S. citizens, permanent residents, dual citizens, or students already enrolled in post-secondary studies. Full scholarship does not cover non-billable expenses such as mandatory health insurance, books, airline tickets, taxes, and miscellaneous expenses (approximately US$4,000 per year out of pocket).
existing.duration: Four years of undergraduate study (renewable based on continued satisfactory academic performance)
existing.application_period: Fall entry; applications open for following year's cycle
existing.program_type: Merit-based university scholarship for international undergraduates (renewable)
